slot.brief: Give a wave on a string as a function and ask the maximum particle velocity (or ratio of particle velocity to wave velocity) using SHM of the medium element.

stem: A transverse wave on a string is described by $y=0.03\sin(50\pi t-2\pi x)$, where $x$ and $y$ are in metres and $t$ is in seconds. What is the maximum speed of a particle of the string?

verdicts.working: For y = A sin(ωt − kx), maximum particle speed is Aω = 0.03 × 50π = 1.5π m s⁻¹.

working:
$A=0.03\ \text{m},\quad \omega=50\pi\ \text{s}^{-1}$
$v_{\max}=A\omega=0.03(50\pi)=1.5\pi\ \text{m s}^{-1}$ Independent check: For y = A sin(ωt − kx), maximum particle speed is Aω = 0.03 × 50π = 1.5π m s⁻¹.
solution:
For $y=A\sin(\omega t-kx)$, the maximum particle speed is $v_{\max}=A\omega$.
$$v_{\max}=0.03(50\pi)=1.5\pi\ \text{m s}^{-1}$$
